# Forward Deployed Engineer — The Walt Disney Company

---
**Job ID:** 10155880
**Date Posted:** Sep 14, 2026
**Date Applied:** Sep 15, 2026
**Salary Range:** $117,500–$157,500 per year — Glendale, CA or Burbank, CA
---

## Job Summary

An early-career builder role in Disney Enterprise Technology's Applied AI Acceleration practice. The engineer partners with teams across Marketing, Finance, Parks Operations, HR, Studios, and other business areas to clarify business problems, build AI-powered products, and put working features in front of users quickly. The small team works in office Monday through Thursday and asks applicants to include a portfolio of impactful work.

---

## What You'll Do

- Build and ship AI-powered features from problem definition through production.
- Work directly with stakeholders to understand business needs and gather feedback.
- Own user experience across workflows, interfaces, automation, and human-in-the-loop decisions.
- Use LLM APIs, prompt design, RAG, agents, and evaluation methods to solve problems.
- Build within Disney's enterprise systems using appropriate security, monitoring, and operational practices.
- Test changes before launch with regression checks, golden sets, and other evaluation methods.
- Contribute reusable code, tools, and patterns for future engagements.
- Partner through code reviews, debugging, and shared problem solving.
- Explain technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly to business stakeholders.

### Required Qualifications
- Minimum three years shipping software products for real users, including at least one year shipping AI-powered features in production
- Experience with prompt design, agents, RAG, LLM APIs, and evaluations
- Daily or frequent use of AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or similar tools
- Ability to read and reason about code, debug with teammates, and work with data using SQL, APIs, or basic transformations
- Strong product and business judgment connecting features to user needs and business outcomes
- Strong learning agility and comfort with new tools and changing technology
- Ability to communicate clearly with senior stakeholders
- Preferred: experience as a product manager, designer, operator, engineer, founder, or builder using AI tools to create working products; building AI products without a dedicated engineering team; forward-deployed engineering; design-engineering instincts; cross-business work; production evaluation methods; strong writing; and enterprise-scale data, legacy systems, or complex stakeholder environments

### Education
A bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, software, electrical or electronics engineering, or a comparable field of study and/or equivalent work experience.

### Benefits
A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be included, along with a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits depending on level and position offered.

---

## How I Match Up

### At Application — Sep 15, 2026

- **Strong builder and product-delivery overlap:** the record shows end-to-end ownership of real products and systems, including ICARUS-Lite commercialization, Gen3 POSEIDON, the customer-specific KRAKEN platform, and an automated LabVIEW QC workflow. The work spans problem definition, multidisciplinary design, validation, delivery, training, troubleshooting, and support.
- **Relevant AI-enabled and user-facing systems:** PROTEOR Print supports remote operation, live video, AI-assisted diagnostics, failure alerts, and manufacturing metrics. The internal skills record also includes Python, LM Studio, workflow automation, Git/GitHub, Docker, and Windows/Linux systems administration.
- **Enterprise and stakeholder experience:** a self-developed Kubernetes-hosted ERP/CRM linked engineering BOMs to purchasing, while the current role includes a Microsoft Business Central implementation across global locations, external software-partner coordination, vendor work, cross-functional support, and after-sales service.
- **The largest gaps are explicit:** the current evidence does not prove three years shipping conventional software products, one year shipping LLM-based AI features in production, or hands-on production use of RAG, LLM APIs, agent frameworks, SQL, golden-set evaluations, trace analysis, LLM-as-judge, Cursor, or Claude Code. It also does not document formal code-review ownership. The tailored resume therefore emphasizes adjacent, supported product and automation evidence without claiming those missing qualifications.
- **Education is adjacent rather than exact:** the completed B.S. in Electro-Mechanical Engineering is closely related to the posting's electrical/electronics or comparable-field language, but it is not a computer science or software degree.

### Now — Sep 16, 2026

No material change since the application one day ago. The strongest evidence remains product ownership, AI-assisted machine diagnostics, user-facing remote operations, workflow automation, enterprise systems, and cross-functional delivery; the production LLM-stack and conventional software-tenure gaps remain open.

---

## About the Company

The role is with Disney Worldwide Services within The Walt Disney Company (Corporate). Disney describes Enterprise Technology as the group delivering technology aligned to business strategy, enterprise efficiency, cross-company innovation, consumer experience, business growth, and operational excellence.
